calibrator_implementation.beta: weighted Bernoulli NLL; logit(q)=c+a*log(p)-b*log(1-p); a,b constrained >=0
calibrator_implementation.class_support: a fitted candidate is ineligible if its FIT data have only one outcome class; IDENTITY remains available
calibrator_implementation.isotonic: weighted PAV monotone nondecreasing mapping; only eligible when frozen protocol support thresholds are met
calibrator_implementation.platt: weighted Bernoulli NLL; logit(q)=a+b*logit(p); b constrained >=1e-6
calibrator_implementation.ridge: weighted Bernoulli NLL + lambda*(sum role_deviation^2 + sum competition_deviation^2); global intercept/slope unpenalized; b>=1e-6
calibrator_implementation.selection: IDENTITY is fallback. Non-identity candidate must have lower SELECT LL than IDENTITY and SELECT Brier <= IDENTITY + frozen tolerance. Choose minimum SELECT LL; among candidates within frozen LL tie tolerance of the minimum, choose earliest full_complexity_order.

final_refit: after method selection per group, refit exactly that selected method on all CALIBRATION rows for the group; no post-refit metric may change the selected method

fixture_balanced_weights.CORNERS_SIDE: each fixture total weight 1; HOME 0.5/AWAY 0.5; six lines equal within role => each cell weight 1/12
fixture_balanced_weights.CORNERS_TOTAL: each fixture total weight 1; six total lines equal => each cell weight 1/6

protected_open_rule: Layer4 outputs may contain no fixture with kickoff >= PROTECTED_START. Protected remains sealed until Layer5 policy freeze.

raw_prediction_contract.corners_joint_mixture: event probabilities are the same fixed convex mixture of complete Poisson and side-NB2 joint distributions for every side/total line
raw_prediction_contract.corners_nb2_alpha: fit one common side-NB2 alpha using eligible dynamic side forecasts and observed side counts with kickoff strictly before CALIBRATION_START; freeze this alpha for all CALIBRATION predictions
raw_prediction_contract.dynamic_state: one chronological walk-forward over all fixtures strictly before PROTECTED; each fixture prediction occurs before its own outcome update
raw_prediction_contract.goals_similar_context: same Layer3 config/features; for each fixture use same-competition labelled PIT rows strictly before kickoff; earlier calibration fixtures may become history only after their kickoff/outcome in chronological order
